name: George Myers
bio: George Myers was a Chimney Butte cowboy to whom Theodore Roosevelt gave a silver-mounted saddle outfit in August 1885, and he rode the 1886 O'Fallon Creek round-up. In December 1886 he was arrested on a Montana Stockgrowers' Association warrant for shipping two steers claimed not to be his in a car of Maltese Cross cattle; the Cow Boy defended him at length and reported that Roosevelt would come back from Europe to testify for him.
